prose: Modern Web Guidance is a Google Chrome-stewarded set of skills that gives coding agents web platform expertise, best practices and browser compatibility data, steering them away from about-2019 legacy JavaScript patterns toward modern web primitives. Mozilla, Microsoft Edge and MDN teams also steward it. Install with an npx wizard, then search and pull guides by topic.
highlights: Skills embed web platform knowledge into coding agents
Stewarded by Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams
Aims agents at modern primitives over legacy patterns
npx install, search and fetch guides
